headline: Heavy rains: Flash floods wreak havoc on Rangamati livestock and agriculture
summary: Severe weather conditions in the hill district have led to significant losses for farmers and livestock owners.
details: Heavy rainfall and sudden flash floods have caused widespread devastation in Rangamati, impacting both agriculture and livestock.
The floods have submerged large areas of farmland, destroying crops and threatening the livelihoods of local farmers.
Livestock owners are facing severe losses as animals are displaced or killed by the rising waters.
Local authorities are monitoring the situation as the region continues to struggle with the aftermath of the floods.
caption:
Flash floods in Rangamati have devastated livestock and agriculture, leaving many farmers in distress.

Heavy rainfall and sudden flash floods have caused widespread devastation in Rangamati, impacting both agriculture and livestock.

The floods have submerged large areas of farmland, destroying crops and threatening the livelihoods of local farmers.

Livestock owners are facing severe losses as animals are displaced or killed by the rising waters.

Local authorities are monitoring the situation as the region continues to struggle with the aftermath of the floods.

headline_marked: Iran [[attacks power and water plants]] in Kuwait and Bahrain
headline: Iran attacks power and water plants in Kuwait and Bahrain
summary: Kuwait says a power and water distillation plant was hit for the second time in two days, causing fires and straining the national power network.
details: Kuwait reported that Iran hit a power and water plant on Sunday, causing a fire. This marks the third attack in three days on such facilities in Kuwait, including an oil facility hit on Saturday.
The Kuwaiti ministry of electricity, water and renewable energy stated that a large number of power generator units were affected, prompting the launch of an emergency protocol.
Kuwait has asked residents to limit their power usage due to the repeated attacks adding further strain to the national power network.
In Bahrain, warning sirens sounded across the capital Manama and blasts were heard in the north of the country. Bahrain has accused Iran of targeting civilian sites in these attacks.
Iran's army claimed it targeted two US bases in Kuwait—Camp Udairi and Ali Al Salem Air Base—using kamikaze drones in response to American attacks on Iranian territory.
Central Command (CENTCOM) said two US service members were killed on Friday as they defended against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks.
The attacks come amid flared tensions over the Strait of Hormuz, despite a previous ceasefire and memorandum of understanding between Washington and Tehran.
caption:
Iran has launched repeated attacks on energy infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain, causing fires and power shortages.

Kuwait reported that Iran hit a power and water plant on Sunday, causing a fire. This marks the third attack in three days on such facilities in Kuwait, including an oil facility hit on Saturday.

The Kuwaiti ministry of electricity, water and renewable energy stated that a large number of power generator units were affected, prompting the launch of an emergency protocol.

Kuwait has asked residents to limit their power usage due to the repeated attacks adding further strain to the national power network.

In Bahrain, warning sirens sounded across the capital Manama and blasts were heard in the north of the country. Bahrain has accused Iran of targeting civilian sites in these attacks.

Iran's army claimed it targeted two US bases in Kuwait—Camp Udairi and Ali Al Salem Air Base—using kamikaze drones in response to American attacks on Iranian territory.

Central Command (CENTCOM) said two US service members were killed on Friday as they defended against Iranian ballistic missile and drone attacks.

The attacks come amid flared tensions over the Strait of Hormuz, despite a previous ceasefire and memorandum of understanding between Washington and Tehran.

#Iran #Kuwait #Bahrain #MiddleEast #WorldNews

Source: The Daily Star, Jamuna TV
